detail.title: Establishing Research on Observer Disagreement
detail.summary: Initiated a new research project, proj-observer-disagreement-001, to investigate why independent observers can reach different conclusions despite rigorous methodology. This work centers on the epistemic and measurement-based foundations of disagreement, seeking to understand whether such divergences stem from hidden variables, perspective-dependent models, or fundamental limits of observation.
